faq.q: Who is Brian Heder in GTA 6?
faq.a: Brian Heder is an established drug runner from the Leonida Keys, described by Rockstar as a classic smuggler from the golden age of the trade. He still moves product through his boat yard.

faq.q: How is Brian Heder connected to Jason Duval?
faq.a: Brian lets Jason live rent-free at one of his properties in exchange for help with local shakedowns and for spending time around his wife, Lori. Their arrangement is part of Jason's life in the Keys.

faq.q: Who is Brian Heder's wife in GTA 6?
faq.a: Lori is named as Brian's third wife in his official biography. She is connected to his boat-yard operation and is part of Jason's circumstances before his partnership with Lucia develops.

faq.q: Does Brian Heder do the criminal work himself?
faq.a: Not entirely. Rockstar describes him as relying on other people, including Jason, to handle much of the dirty work while he continues running product through the boat yard with Lori.

faq.q: What happens to Brian Heder later in the GTA 6 story?
faq.a: Rockstar has not said. The official material only covers his boat-yard operation, his marriage to Lori, and his working relationship with Jason and Cal Hampton, without detailing any later story outcome.
